resources.string: Thinta inkanyezi ukuze imali ihlale phezulu ohlwini. Imali elenkanyezi yiyo etshengiswa ngamawijethi akho, liwatshi lakho lesikrini sama-Amazinga.
Swayiphe ikhadi ukuze ufihle leyo mali. Imali efihliweyo ibuya ngemenyu.
Ukuvuselela ngakunye kwamazinga kudla uhlamvu olulodwa. Thinta ibhalansi yakho ukuyengeza.
Thinta loba yisiphi isiyingi ukuze uguqule usuka kuleyo mali, ubusufaka inani ukuze ubone ukuthi lilingana lokungakanani kwezinye.
